text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after having won
many races together with Tokai Teio—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer? Do you remember?
That ticket I gave you to hold onto earlier?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Remember that hot spring trip voucher I won from the raffle? Back when I'd just entered the Senior Class...
choice_data_list: Hot spring trip tickets? Now that you mention it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Being told that... I remembered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The hot springs voucher Tokai Teio mentioned wanting to use 'with someone' once the Twinkle Series had wrapped up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've made sure to keep it safe, of course.
Just as I reach into my pocket to hand it over—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"About that coupon...
It's okay, you don't have to give it back."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This is for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She could have just gone with Symboli Rudolf. Or with one of her friends. And yet, why did she—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because, like... there's no point in having you pay me back anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If we're going together, it doesn't matter
whether I carry it or you carry it, right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've decided!
The person who's going to the hot springs with me is...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That would be—
Ta-da! It's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head out to the after-party!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, together with an exuberant Tokai Teio, we headed to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wondering a little why I was the one chosen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whew... I feel so relaxed~. Just staring at the hot water and taking in the view~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"This kind of thing is nice, too.
Feels a bit grown-up."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Did you have fun too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I had fun, but... why with me?
I had fun, but... why with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The doubt I felt slipped out of my mouth before I could stop it. Usually, she'd want to go with one of her friends.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...? Isn't it obvious?
Because—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The whole reason I came was for a 'Hot Springs Trip'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still tilting my head in confusion as I returned to my room,
Tokai Teio came over to hang out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Guess you don't get it, huh?
Well, just hear me out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, in the first place... if I go with the President,
that wouldn't be a "hot spring trip" anymore, it'd just be a
"President trip," wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because you'd just stare at the President the whole time
and forget all about the hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even if I came with one of my friends, yep! It'd just turn into
a 'friends trip' where we goof off the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's not what I wanted this time. I just wanted a normal trip.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You know, I was almost never really by myself before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When she's alone... To be sure, Tokai Teio had always been surrounded by people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loved by everyone, and if they don't come to her, she'll jump right in herself.
Such an innocent and carefree Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've gotten faster, right?
Just like the Prez. But...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez is amazing at things outside of running too,
but I feel like I'm not really all that great.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it doesn't seem that amazing
because she never had any time to herself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even I can properly appreciate how nice
a hot spring feels when I take a dip.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then you think, 'The scenery is so pretty, too.'
It kind of makes your heart flutter a little.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez probably wouldn't feel this way.
But... that's how I felt.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure learning all sorts of things will change me too."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not an "Empress" who surpasses the "Emperor,"
but an "Empress" entirely distinct from the "Emperor"――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, Tokai Teio's innocent expression
seemed to look just a little mature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio has certainly grown a lot.
Though that's in terms of her running—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her heart, she has only just taken her first step past girlhood.
Her journey to becoming a wonderful Umamusume has only just begun...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm really glad I came with you today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If I'd come with anyone else, I definitely wouldn't have felt this way.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't mind me being here?
You don't mind me being here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she wants some time to herself, I might just be in the way, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's fine for you, Trainer.
'Cause... you're my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They teach me things I don't know and give me advice,
helping me become the 'me' I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is different from other girls,
you're not just some other person...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer is the person
who makes me Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those eyes shone with absolute, unreserved trust.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether Tokai Teio grows into an elegant lady
or an energetic big sister...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The straightforward look in these eyes... will surely never change.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on Trainer, we're eating after this!
They're serving delicious things I've never even heard of.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tell me what kind of dish it is!
I'm gonna savor every bite!
choice_data_list: You're not binge eating, are you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Of course I am!
I'm already starving over here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm totally gonna study hard before heading home! So, teach me all kinds of stuff, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, I sat down side by side with Tokai Teio
and enjoyed a fun meal together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
between Tokai Teio and myself...
